papers.title_en: Motion- and Gravity-Aware Feedforward 3D Reconstruction
papers.authors: Shiyao Qian, Yuan Ren, Dongfeng Bai
papers.evidence: 改进前馈Transformer多视图三维重建的几何表征
papers.tldr: 前馈式多视图三维重建虽表现强劲，却主要依赖外观注意力，在动态物体、结构含糊和相机运动复杂的场景中仍易受弱几何线索影响。本文采用特权信息学习范式，在训练时利用残差光流与重力方向引导几何表征，推理时仍只需常规视觉输入。研究以轻量结构改动将先验融入 Transformer，并发现 VGGT 宜在中层注入、π3 宜在后层注入。标准基准结果显示，该方法稳定提升重建精度与鲁棒性，提供了不增加测试开销的先验融合途径。
papers.abstract_en: Feed-forward transformer models have recently achieved strong performance in multi-view 3D reconstruction, but they still rely primarily on appearance-based attention and often struggle in dynamic scenes with weak geometric cues. In this work, we introduce a motion- and gravity-aware framework under the Learning Using Privileged Information (LUPI) paradigm. During training, residual optical flow and gravity direction are provided as privileged signals to guide geometric representation learning; during inference, the model uses standard visual inputs only.   We integrate these priors into transformer backbones with lightweight architectural changes, preserving feed-forward efficiency. Experiments on standard benchmarks show consistent gains in reconstruction accuracy and robustness, especially in scenes with dynamic objects, ambiguous structure, and challenging camera motion. Our analysis further shows that the optimal injection stage is backbone-dependent: middle-layer integration is generally preferable for VGGT, while late-stage integration is more effective for π3. These results suggest that LUPI offers a practical way to inject motion and physical priors into feed-forward 3D reconstruction without increasing test-time complexity.

papers.title_en: GenIA: Generative Reconstruction with Test-Time Input Alignment
papers.authors: Stefano Esposito, Naama Pearl, Polina Karpikova, Samuel Rota Bulò, Lorenzo Porzi, Peter Kontschieder, Andreas Geiger, Jonathon Luiten
papers.evidence: 从单目或稀疏多视图生成并对齐三维物体几何
papers.tldr: 从单目、稀疏多视图或动态观测恢复完整三维物体时，生成模型虽能补全未见区域，却可能偏离输入的几何、外观与姿态。GenIA无需重训SAM3D，而是在测试时利用几何观测校准平移和尺度、保留学习到的旋转先验，并以注意力融合和去噪渲染引导对齐外观。可选的后处理还会调整外观潜变量、轻量解码器适配器及物体位置，也支持外部几何和动态形状。合成与真实基准结果显示，该方法提升多种输入条件下的姿态和重建表现，为可信的输入对齐三维生成提供实用框架。
papers.abstract_en: Reconstructing complete 3D object assets from monocular or sparse multi-view observations remains challenging. Generative 3D foundation models can complete object geometry beyond the observed views, but their predictions may not faithfully reproduce the observed geometry, appearance, or pose. We introduce GenIA, a framework for test-time input-aligned generation that grounds SAM3D's generative prior in geometric and photometric observations without retraining the foundation model. We improve object pose by deriving translation and scale from geometry while retaining the learned rotation prior, and align appearance through visibility-biased attention, cross-observation fusion, and differentiable rendering guidance during denoising. An optional post-denoising refinement further adapts the appearance latent, lightweight decoder adapters, and object placement to the observations. Our framework also supports externally supplied geometry; when given temporal shapes of dynamic objects, it recovers a shared, input-aligned canonical appearance and stable world-space placement. Across synthetic and real benchmarks, GenIA improves pose prediction and object reconstruction from monocular, multi-view, and dynamic inputs, outperforming recent optimization-based, per-frame image-to-3D, and video-to-4D methods. Our project page is available at https://facebookresearch.github.io/GenIA.

papers.title_en: Learning to See through Action: Predictive Curiosity for Robots
papers.authors: Stelios Zarifis, Panagiotis Filntisis, George Retsinas, Petros Maragos
papers.evidence: 机器人通过交互学习视觉并训练行动条件世界模型
papers.tldr: 机器人通常从固定数据中学习视觉，难以主动获得能拓展认知的经验；人和动物则会通过行动观察视觉变化。研究提出自监督框架 DySCOVER，让机器人学习重建图像的视觉自编码器，并用循环世界模型预测动作后的视觉状态。策略以重建误差和预测误差作为内在奖励，分别驱动视觉新奇探索与尚不可预测的状态转移。机械臂实验表明，预测好奇心在不同初始条件、经验容量、机器人形态和场景中均能提升视觉学习效果，优于单用视觉新奇奖励。结果说明，主动预测行动后果可丰富机器人经验，增强视觉学习。
papers.abstract_en: Humans and animals do not learn vision from a fixed set of data: they move, interact, and learn from the visual consequences of their actions. Motivated by this developmental view, we study whether robots can improve visual learning by actively collecting experience through curiosity-driven interaction. We introduce DySCOVER, a self-supervised framework for active robot visual learning. A robot observes RGB frames, learns a visual autoencoder that encodes and reconstructs them, and trains a recurrent world model to predict the next visual latent state conditioned on the current state and action. The agent's policy is trained only with intrinsic rewards: reconstruction error encourages visually novel observations, while the world model's error encourages transitions whose consequences are not yet predictable. This prediction error biases the policy toward more intricate trajectories that enrich the agent's set of experiences with observations beyond those encouraged by visual novelty alone. Our experiments conducted with robotic arms as the embodied agents show that adding predictive curiosity improves the vision model over using visual curiosity alone. Across variations in initial conditions, experience capacity, embodiment, and scene content, adding predictive curiosity consistently improved visual learning. These results show that predictive curiosity can improve active visual learning beyond reconstruction-based curiosity alone.

papers.title_en: MvFFN: Multi-view Floor plan Feed-forward Network for Unposed Wide-Baseline Panorama Layout Reconstruction
papers.authors: Yuguang Li, Yichuan Deng, Zixuan Liu, Ivaylo Boyadzhiev, Xiuyuan Wu, Xinyu Zou, Linda Shapiro, Alex Colburn
papers.evidence: 从未定姿全景图重建相机位姿与多房间平面布局，直接涉及三维几何重建。
papers.tldr: 从稀疏、无位姿且宽基线的室内全景恢复相机位姿与多房间平面图，难点在于几何、语义和全局结构相互耦合，直接整体预测不易稳定。MvFFN提出多视角有序墙实例分割，让每列仅预测当前墙及顺时针相邻两墙，再聚合重叠局部结果。网络联合估计粗位姿、稠密全局几何和逐墙语义，并经布局链后处理形成共享坐标、墙身份一致且房间连通的布局。实验显示其墙体与交点精度优于既有方法，并以ZInD-CrossView数据集支持跨视角评测。
papers.abstract_en: Reconstructing accurate camera poses and floor-plan layouts from sparse, unposed, wide-baseline RGB panoramas remains a challenging open problem. Direct multi-room floor-plan prediction is especially difficult in this setting: pose, geometry, semantics, and global layout structure are tightly coupled, yet a complete floor-plan is hard to learn as a single global output. Our key insight is to keep the model's predictions strictly local. Multi-view Ordered Wall Instance Segmentation (MOIS) is designed around this concept. Each panorama column predicts only the wall it observes plus the next two adjacent walls in clockwise order. The global wall partition, room layouts, and shared coordinates emerge from deterministic aggregation of overlapping local predictions. Building on MOIS, we propose Multi-view floor-plan Feed-Forward Network (MvFFN), which jointly predicts coarse camera poses, dense global geometry, and per-wall semantic outputs. A downstream Layout Chaining (LC) post processing pipeline then assembles these predictions into multi-room floor-plans with shared global coordinates, consistent wall identities, and connected room structure. The dense MOIS predictions recover cross-view wall identity and local within-room connectivity more accurately than composed modular baselines, and the assembled layouts substantially outperform prior methods on wall and junction level accuracy. We also introduce the ZInD-CrossView dataset, which augments ZInD with globally unique wall instances and cross-view segmentation labels for this task.

papers.title_en: Look Before You Move: Agent-Interface-Aligned Supervision for Open-World Mobile Manipulation
papers.authors: Ronghe Qiu, Teli Ma, Jiaming Zhou, Zeying Gong, Yiting He, Qiang Huang, Junwei Liang
papers.evidence: 语言指令驱动的开放环境移动操作与主动视觉
papers.tldr: 开放世界移动操作要求机器人按语言指令寻找物体、接近并将其放入目标容器；仅将规划轨迹转为高层动作标签，难以监督何时观察及如何找回丢失目标。论文提出AIDA，让教师直接经部署时使用的技能接口选择并执行动作，并加入保持目标可见、重新搜索和接近抓放的示范，以及空间推理监督。所得AIDA-OWMM在170个留出回合中完整任务成功率为71.76%，主动视觉示范能提升学生表现。仿真训练模型未经额外训练，在真实移动机器人上成功率达38%，并在导航基准上验证了流程的适用性。
papers.abstract_en: Open-world mobile manipulation requires a robot to find an object, approach it, and move it to a target receptacle from a language instruction. Training vision-language model (VLM) agents for these tasks requires demonstrations of both action selection and active vision. Existing pipelines often convert planned trajectories into high-level action labels, but shortest-path progress provides limited supervision for deciding where to look. We introduce Agent-Interface Data Alignment (AIDA), a data collection pipeline in which a teacher directly selects and executes actions through the deployed agent's skill interface. For mobile manipulation, we design teachers that maintain target visibility, recover lost targets, and approach for picking or placing. We add template-based spatial reasoning supervision and use a shared harness to organize observations, history, and outputs during training and inference. The resulting agent, AIDA-OWMM, achieves 71.76% full-task success on 170 held-out OWMM episodes. Teacher sensitivity analysis shows that active-vision demonstrations improve student success. The simulation-trained agent achieves 38% end-to-end success on a real mobile robot without additional training. Applying AIDA to a navigation subset of EmbodiedBench further demonstrates the pipeline's utility for navigation tasks.

papers.title_en: Physical SLAM: Physics-aware Simultaneous Localisation and Mapping
papers.authors: Guangming Wang, Zhishuo Liu, Haibing Wu, Wanli Ma, Yixiong Jing, Olaf Wysocki, Brian Sheil
papers.evidence: 从移动相机观测重建动态场景并预测外力作用后的状态
papers.tldr: 从移动相机采集的RGB-D序列中恢复可预测的动态场景，既要定位相机、重建形变物体，也要推断其受外力后的运动。Physical SLAM以静态高斯场定位相机，以弹簧质点模型驱动物体高斯场；虚拟观测力融合深度观测，物理参数则根据全时窗误差更新。物理表面对齐约束几何与外观。实验在PhysTwin上重建和预测PSNR分别提升10.4%和11.0%，在TUM RGB-D上跟踪误差降低20.6%。该方法使SLAM地图从场景重建扩展为可进行动作条件模拟的物理表示。
papers.abstract_en: To reconstruct a predictive 4D representation of the physical world from monocular video captured by a moving camera, we jointly reconstruct dynamic Gaussian radiance fields and infer their underlying physical dynamics. This paper proposes \emph{Physical SLAM}, a physics-aware method for constructing 4D Gaussian fields of deformable objects and predicting their future state when subjected to external actions, given a sequence of RGB-D images. Our method separates the scene into a static background Gaussian field for camera localization and a dynamic object Gaussian field driven by a spring--mass physical model of elastic deformation, inertia, and damping. To integrate visual observations with physical dynamics, we introduce virtual observation forces that gradually pull simulated surface nodes toward observed depth points, avoiding abrupt replacement of simulated node positions. Meanwhile, the physical parameters of the spring--mass model are updated from simulation errors aggregated over the full reconstruction observation window, enabling the reconstructed dynamics to align with observations. To couple appearance, geometry, and physics, we further design a physics-aware Gaussian transformation and surface alignment strategy, where dynamic Gaussians are transformed along the deforming physical surface of the spring--mass model and constrained to remain aligned with the surface during rendering-based optimization. The resulting representation supports observed-frame rendering and action-conditioned simulation, extending SLAM maps to describe how deformable objects respond to manipulation. On the PhysTwin benchmark, our method improves reconstruction and prediction PSNR over PhysTwin by 10.4\% and 11.0\%, respectively. On the TUM RGB-D benchmark, it reduces average camera tracking error by 20.6\%, improves SSIM by 3.6\%, and reduces LPIPS by 8.3\% compared with 4DGS-SLAM.

papers.title_en: GreenWAM: A World Foundation Model for Robotics
papers.authors: Gennady Sidorov, Valerii Kornilov, Denis Grankin, Polina Fedotova, Aleksey Postnikov
papers.evidence: 机器人世界模型预测动作对场景的影响，并连接感知、动作与策略。
papers.tldr: 机器人既需要预测动作对场景影响的世界模型，也需要据此选择动作的策略；但既有研究往往分开构建，且不同机器人动作格式不统一。GreenWAM以覆盖20类机器人的共享解剖学关节动作空间为基础，联合训练视觉、动作条件世界预测与世界动作模式，并从生成器拆分动作专家形成策略。它在WorldArena 1.0取得领先的轨迹、深度和三维准确度，在RoboTwin 2.0、LIBERO-plus等任务表现突出，也适配真实人形机器人并可蒸馏为单步实时策略。实验显示，机器人专门化、早期拆分动作专家及保留世界模型模式均有益，说明统一模型可兼顾跨本体预测与控制。
papers.abstract_en: A robot needs a world model that predicts how its actions will change the scene and a policy that chooses those actions. Models are usually built and evaluated for only one of these roles, and every robot records its actions in its own format. We ask whether one robot world model can serve both roles across different bodies, and what makes this work. We present GreenWAM, a world foundation model for robotics, together with the recipe that produces it: (1) a shared anatomical action space that describes 20 robot families, from bimanual arms to dexterous humanoids, in common joint coordinates; (2) joint training on these families in visual, action-conditioned and world-action modes; and (3) policies that split an action expert off the generator. As a world model, GreenWAM attains top-tier trajectory, depth and 3D accuracy on WorldArena 1.0, ahead of every world-action model and video generator in our comparison. As a policy, it scores among the top entries of the RoboTwin 2.0 leaderboard, reaches the highest zero-shot LIBERO-plus success among the compared methods and is competitive with dedicated vision-language-action and world-action policies on CALVIN and LIBERO. We further adapt GreenWAM to a real humanoid, where it succeeds more often than policies adapted from $π_{0.5}$ and from Cosmos 3 Edge, and distill it into a single-step policy for real-time control. Controlled experiments yield three findings: robot specialization improves world prediction and control together; an action expert helps when split off at the start of adaptation; and keeping world-model modes during policy adaptation preserves robustness to scene changes.

papers.title_en: Physical AI: A Survey of Models, Learning, Systems, and Open Challenges
papers.authors: Bin Gao, Anuj Gautam, Aritra Bagchi, Yunkai Liang, Wentao Li, Ronghui Li, Zhi Zhou, Yancan Mao, Xiao Yan, Xin He, Qingyun Zou, Wenshuo Yue, Dan Chen, Zhanglu Yan, Fei Xu, Huize Li, Weijie Wang, Tao Ouyang, Tulika Mitra
papers.evidence: 综述物理智能体通过感知、推理、行动和交互学习的系统与方法。
papers.tldr: 物理智能体需在部分可观测、动力学不确定且受具身与实时约束的环境中持续感知和行动，单项模型进步不足以保证可靠自主。本文沿物理交互闭环，系统梳理任务表示与记忆、预测和动作生成、数据学习、具身控制、计算系统、评测及安全。综述整合分析这些环节如何共同塑造系统能力与局限，并归纳泛化、资源效率、状态跟踪、安全、恢复和持续适应等关键挑战。其核心意义是推动研究从孤立模型性能转向稳健、高效、安全并能适应变化环境的集成式物理智能系统。
papers.abstract_en: Physical AI aims to enable intelligent systems to perceive, reason, act, and learn through interaction with the physical world. Unlike purely digital intelligence, physical agents must operate under partial observability, uncertain dynamics, embodiment constraints, and real-time requirements, while their actions continuously reshape the environment and subsequent observations. Recent advances in foundation models and robot learning have expanded the capabilities of physical agents, yet achieving reliable autonomy requires more than improvements in individual models. This survey presents a comprehensive, system-level review of Physical AI, organized around the closed-loop process of physical interaction. We examine the foundations and recent developments in task representations and memory, predictive and action-generating models, data and learning methods, embodiment and control, computing systems, evaluation, and safety. Beyond reviewing individual advances, we investigate how these components interact and collectively shape the capabilities and limitations of Physical AI systems. Building on this integrated perspective, we identify fundamental challenges in generalization, resource-efficient learning and execution, reliable state tracking, safety, recovery, and continual adaptation. We argue that advancing Physical AI requires moving beyond isolated model performance toward integrated systems capable of robust, efficient, safe, and autonomous physical interaction under changing real-world conditions.

papers.title_en: GeoPano: Towards Geometrically Accurate 3D Reconstruction from a Single Panorama
papers.authors: Jing OU, Zidong Cao, Liaoyuan Fan, Zhuoxiao Li, Shuai Zhang, Yinrui Ren, Dongli Wu, Haoang Li, Hui Xiong, Wufan Zhao
papers.evidence: 从单幅全景图前馈重建几何准确且跨视图一致的三维点云
papers.tldr: 全景图能够提供完整的三百六十度场景信息，但直接从ERP图像恢复几何会受到球面投影畸变影响。将图像拆成透视视图可缓解畸变，却可能使各视图的重建结果彼此不一致。GeoPano提出全景感知注意力聚合器，通过Pano-Attention利用球面几何引导跨视图交互，并以混合监督兼顾透视空间的局部细节与球面空间的整体结构。实验表明，该方法在重建准确度、几何一致性和视觉保真度上显著优于此前先进方法，为单张全景图恢复可靠完整的三维场景提供了有效方案。
papers.abstract_en: Panoramic 3D reconstruction enables the holistic recovery of complete 360 $^\circ$ scene geometry, offering significant benefits for robotics and AR/VR applications. However, directly estimating geometry from ERP images is inherently challenged by spherical distortions. To reduce spherical projection distortions, a common strategy is to decompose panoramas into distortion-free perspective views, but independently processing these views often introduces cross-view geometric inconsistencies. To address these challenges, we introduce GeoPano, a feed-forward framework for single-view panoramic 3D reconstruction that recovers a geometrically accurate and consistent point cloud from a single panorama. Our approach is driven by two key innovations: First, we propose a panoramic-aware attention aggregator, featuring a streamlined attention architecture equipped with a novel Pano-Attention mechanism, which explicitly exploits the intrinsic spherical geometry of the panorama to guide cross-view interactions, thereby suppressing geometric inconsistencies. Furthermore, we formulate a hybrid supervision strategy to jointly enforce fine-grained local details in perspective space and global structural coherence in spherical space. Experiments demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms previous SOTA approaches in reconstruction accuracy, geometric consistency, and visual fidelity.

papers.title_en: T2-z: Test-Time Optimization of Environment Latents for Robotic World Models
papers.authors: Chenyuan Zhou, Yining Hong, Huang Huang, Yunfan Jiang, Wenlong Huang, David Held, Vitor Campagnolo Guizilini, Yue Wang, Li Fei-Fei, Jiajun Wu, Leonidas Guibas, Yejin Choi
papers.evidence: 通过环境潜变量增强机器人动作条件世界模型
papers.tldr: 机器人要预测动作会如何改变世界，除了视觉信息，还需考虑摩擦、质量和人为规则等未知环境因素。T2-Z为世界模型引入可学习的环境潜变量，训练时交替学习跨环境动力学与潜变量，测试时冻结模型并用新环境交互优化潜变量。该方法在7种模拟设置和4项真实任务中，将物体预测误差从15.20降至7.00，动作成功率从33.73%升至72.96%。结果表明，少量交互即可适应未见环境，且潜变量能形成结构化环境表征。
papers.abstract_en: Predicting how the world responds to an action requires more than what can be seen: robots must account for environmental factors that are neither directly observable nor explicitly specified, from physical properties such as friction and mass to human-defined environmental rules. We introduce T2-Z for test-time optimization of environment latents, which augments a robotic world model with a learnable environment latent to condition world predictions. This compact latent captures underlying environmental variation without supervision of what environmental factors exist or what values they take. During training, T2-Z alternates between two stages: a world-model optimization stage that fixes the latents and learns general action-conditioned dynamics across environments; and an environment-latent optimization stage that freezes the world model and optimizes the conditioning latents, allowing latent structure to emerge purely through world prediction. At test time, the world model remains frozen and a newly initialized environment latent is optimized from one or more test-time interactions, adapting the model to previously unseen environmental configurations. Across 7 simulated settings and 4 real-world robotic tasks, T2-Z reduces object prediction error metric from 15.20 to 7.00 and raises action success from 33.73% to 72.96%. Its emergent latents capture structured representations of individual and compounded factors across diverse visual scenes. Ablations further show that T2-Z can efficiently infer environment latents from as little as a single test-time interaction trajectory.

papers.title_en: LynxScenes: A Large-Scale Real-World Benchmark for Outdoor Wheel-Legged Robot Perception, Navigation, Imagination and Reconstruction
papers.authors: Jun Tian, Hao Wu, Ruo Chen, Yili Liao, Hongyi Lin, Jincheng Yu, Chao Li, Yingjie Niu
papers.evidence: 真实轮足机器人感知、导航与重建的综合基准
papers.tldr: 户外人机共享环境中的轮足机器人，需要同时具备可靠感知、符合社会规范的导航、未来场景推理与场景重建能力，但现有数据集往往只支持其中一项，且缺少真实平台上的密集监督。LynxScenes基于LYNX M20采集约10万段导航片段，覆盖833.6小时、3294.7公里和300万标注帧，并同步记录多相机、激光雷达及运动状态。数据提供三维目标、道路结构和分层导航指令，支持轨迹预测、鸟瞰感知、未来场景预测与多视角重建，并以回放式伪闭环评估安全、进展和指令遵循。多类方法评测揭示近距离户外导航仍具挑战，为相关研究提供统一基准。
papers.abstract_en: Wheel-legged robots operating in outdoor spaces shared with humans require accurate perception, socially compliant navigation, future-scene reasoning, and scene reconstruction. However, existing datasets typically support these capabilities in isolation and rarely provide dense spatial and behavior-level supervision on real wheel-legged platforms. We introduce LynxScenes, a large-scale real-world dataset and benchmark collected with a LYNX M20 wheel-legged robot. It contains approximately 100K 30-s navigation clips spanning 833.6 h and 3,294.7 km, with 3.0M annotated frames. The synchronized recordings include four fisheye cameras, dual LiDARs, IMU, odometry, and robot states. Annotations comprise 20.82M oriented 3D boxes across 27 categories, 13.89M road-structure annotations, and 20 navigation instructions organized into three layers and aligned with continuous future trajectories. LynxScenes supports four complementary tasks: instruction-conditioned trajectory prediction, BEV-based perception of 3D objects and road structures, future scene prediction, and multi-view scene reconstruction. For trajectory prediction, we further introduce a log-replay-based pseudo-closed-loop evaluator that measures safety, progress, and instruction compliance beyond trajectory imitation. Extensive evaluations across representative navigation, perception, world-model, and reconstruction methods reveal substantial remaining challenges in close-range outdoor robot navigation. The dataset and evaluation toolkit are planned for public release.

papers.title_en: SpatialHarness: Test-Time Spatial Scaffolding for Fine Robotic Manipulation
papers.authors: Jiayu Wang, Yue Yu, Bin Zhu, Zhiyao Yang, Jingjing Chen
papers.evidence: 在线同步模拟场景揭示精细操作所需的空间关系
papers.tldr: 多模态基础模型已展现直接控制机器人的潜力，但精细操作仍常因相机视角未充分呈现关键空间关系而失败。SpatialHarness在测试时同步真实执行与在线模拟场景，识别任务所需关系并生成互补虚拟视图，提供给冻结的GPT-6 Astra策略。四项真实机器人任务的结果显示，插头插入成功率从26.7%提升至66.7%，汉诺塔从0%提升至100%。这表明无需微调策略或改动实体传感配置，仅增强空间可观测性也能释放模型的精细操作能力。
papers.abstract_en: Frontier multimodal foundation models (e.g., GPT-6 Astra) have recently shown strong potential for direct robotic control, yet their performance on fine manipulation remains limited. We argue that an important source of failure is not necessarily insufficient policy capability, but insufficient spatial observability, where task-critical spatial relationships may be poorly revealed by the existing physical camera setup. We introduce SpatialHarness, a test-time embodied harness that provides test-time spatial scaffolding for fine robotic manipulation without policy fine-tuning or changes to the physical sensing setup. SpatialHarness maintains an online simulated scene synchronized with real-world execution, identifies task-critical spatial relationships, and renders complementary virtual views that expose them to a frozen multimodal policy. To keep the simulated scene aligned during interaction, we develop interaction-aware scene synchronization that distinguishes static, held, and transition modes. We evaluate SpatialHarness on four real-robot manipulation tasks spanning precise geometric alignment, object-relative placement, and articulated-object interaction. Using the same frozen GPT-6 Astra policy, SpatialHarness substantially improves task success, including from 26.7% to 66.7% on plug insertion and from 0% to 100% on Tower of Hanoi. These results indicate that improving spatial observability at test time can unlock fine-manipulation capabilities already present in strong multimodal foundation models. Project website: https://emilia113.github.io/SpatialHarness/.

papers.title_en: What Should Embodied Agents Remember? Benchmarking and Evaluating Memory Modality for Embodied Agents
papers.authors: Junxiang Wang, Yuchen Liu, Yi Wu, Guofei Chen, Nir Pechuk, Tao Chen, Zackory Erickson, Yuzhe Qin, Tianyu Li
papers.evidence: 评测具身智能体的记忆模态及后续任务能力
papers.tldr: 具身智能体需要利用过去经验完成任务，但机器人观察包含视觉与空间信息，记忆形式会影响任务表现及推理成本。论文提出MeMoREval，让智能体先经历未知后续任务的事件，再仅凭记忆处理信息查询和行动请求。基准覆盖4个模拟室内环境、53项任务，并同时评估成功率与记忆构建和使用成本。结果显示，主要模型存储图像帧优于生成描述，兼具更高成功率和更低写入成本；图像帧加场景图则在所有受测模型中综合成功率最高。该基准也支持多种记忆设计扩展，并通过实体机器人演示验证其应用可行性。
papers.abstract_en: Memory allows large language model (LLM) agents to use past experience, often stored as textual records, when responding to requests. For embodied agents that control robots, visual and spatial observations introduce a broader choice of memory modalities, affecting both the information available for subsequent tasks and the model inference costs of constructing and using memory. We introduce MeMoREval, a benchmark for studying this problem through a controlled experience-request protocol. Agents first experience a sequence of events without knowing the subsequent tasks, and subsequently they use memory to respond to information and action requests without receiving new observations. The benchmark comprises 53 tasks across four simulated indoor environments and measures task success alongside the inference costs of memory construction and use. Our reference evaluations reveal that storing frames outperforms storing generated descriptions at lower write-time inference cost for the primary model, while storing frames with scene graphs achieves the highest aggregate task success for every tested model. Extensions to accumulated experience, selective frame retention, and visual input to memory writers demonstrate how the benchmark accommodates further memory-design investigations. Two physical-robot demonstrations establish the feasibility of applying its protocol beyond simulation.

papers.title_en: Measurable Semantic 3D Gaussian Splatting with Joint Region and Depth Supervision for Interactive Building Inspection
papers.authors: Yi Zhang, Tian Tan, Ray Kai Leung Su
papers.evidence: 多视图图像三维重建并联合区域语义和深度监督
papers.tldr: 建筑巡检需要的不只是逼真三维模型，还包括可靠的尺寸测量、构件语义识别与便捷交互。本文提出带区域和深度监督的三维高斯泼溅框架，以掩膜聚焦目标，并用多视角立体点云约束高斯中心贴近真实表面。框架还为高斯基元学习语义特征，并集成于支持可视化、测量和多模态大模型交互的平台。两组数据实验中，深度误差分别降低58.1%和86.8%，港大数据集的高度、宽度和面积相对误差为0.33%、1.07%和0.60%。这使重建结果成为兼具可测量性、语义结构与交互能力的工程巡检表示。
papers.abstract_en: Image-based 3D reconstruction provides a scalable representation for building inspection and maintenance. However, photorealistic reconstruction alone does not fully provide the geometric measurability, semantic structure, and interactive information access required for engineering applications. This study proposes a measurable semantic 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) framework with region and depth supervision for interactive building inspection from multi-view imagery. Mask-based region supervision suppresses irrelevant backgrounds and focuses optimization on target regions. Point-wise depth supervision guides Gaussian centers toward physical surfaces using reference geometry derived from multi-view stereo (MVS) point clouds, providing geometric anchors for measuring physical dimensions and areas. A semantic Gaussian field associates learnable class features with individual Gaussian primitives, enabling semantic rendering and component-level inspection. These capabilities are operationalized through AEC-SplatTwin, an interactive building inspection platform supporting real-time visualization, semantic analysis, quantitative measurement, and multimodal large language model (MLLM)-assisted interaction. On the synthetic UAV-inspection QuakeCity and smartphone-captured HKUPB datasets, the framework reduces Gaussian-center depth MAE by 58.1% and 86.8%, while its semantic field achieves mIoU values of 0.8529 and 0.8642. On HKUPB, the mean relative errors for height, width, and area measurements are 0.33%, 1.07%, and 0.60%. These results show that the proposed framework extends 3DGS beyond visual reconstruction into a measurable, semantically structured, and interactive engineering representation for building inspection.

papers.title_en: Grounded-Dreamer: Robot Learning from World Model Synthetic Data with Physical Grounding
papers.authors: Feng Jiang, Shu Chen, Yuanfei Wang, Yuan Li, Zhenhao Shen, Jiaqi Liang, Yang Chen, Lei Wei, Chen Xie, Ruihai Wu
papers.evidence: 利用物理落地的合成数据训练机器人操作策略
papers.tldr: 机器人操作策略的扩展受制于大规模、多样化且带动作标签的数据需求，真实采集昂贵，仿真视觉效果有限，公开视频则缺少机器人本体标注。Grounded-Dreamer从少量真实任务初始图像出发，重建场景并在仿真中获取物理有效轨迹，再用其训练视频世界模型与逆动力学模型。模型生成操作视频及对应动作后，轨迹会在重建仿真中回放，只有成功完成任务的样本才保留。真实机器人策略仅用筛选后的合成轨迹训练，实验显示该方法能促进真实任务学习并减少人工遥操作示范需求。
papers.abstract_en: Scaling robot manipulation policies requires large amounts of diverse, action-labeled data, yet collecting such data in the real world remains expensive and difficult to scale. Existing methods either depend on human teleoperation, rely on simulation with limited visual realism, or use human videos that lack embodiment-specific annotations. In this paper, we introduce Grounded-Dreamer, a framework for synthesizing physically grounded robot manipulation data with video world models while avoiding human teleoperation demonstrations. Grounded-Dreamer combines the visual realism of generative video models with simulator physics engines. Starting from a small set of real images depicting robot task initial states, our method automatically reconstructs task-relevant objects and camera geometry, aligns them in simulation, and collects physically valid trajectories. These trajectories are used to post-train both a video world model and an inverse dynamics model, enabling the generation of visually realistic robot manipulation videos and corresponding robot actions from real images. To filter physically implausible rollouts, Grounded-Dreamer replays generated trajectories in the reconstructed simulation and retains only those that successfully complete the tasks. The real-world robot policies are trained solely on the grounded synthetic trajectories without any human demonstrations. Empirical results in real-world tasks demonstrate that Grounded-Dreamer can synthesize physically grounded data and substantially facilitate policy learning without requiring human teleoperation effort.

papers.title_en: UniMetric: Universal Metric Scale Recovery for Visual Geometry Foundation Models
papers.authors: Lei Yang, Yuner Zhang, Ziyang Liu, Ziying Song, Kai WU, Yiyang Gao, Jiangtao Su, Yiming Li
papers.evidence: 为视觉几何基础模型恢复重建的度量尺度
papers.tldr: 视觉几何基础模型可恢复场景结构与相机运动，却常缺乏可靠的米制尺度，限制互联网视频用于具身预训练。UniMetric无需额外传感器或任务专属尺度监督，利用视觉语言模型估计常见物体高度区间，并结合重建几何融合多帧约束，恢复全序列统一尺度。在涵盖12个子集、9种模型的基准测试中，深度相对误差、重建倒角距离和轨迹误差分别降低54.2%、83.8%和65.6%。该工作提出通用免训练校准框架，并发布带传感器真值的MetricBench。
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in multimodal foundation models, exemplified by GPT-6 Astra, raise the prospect of general-purpose embodied reasoning and planning. Using Internet videos for embodied pretraining calls for reliable physical-scale annotations. Yet visual geometry foundation models often recover scene structure and camera motion without reliable metric scale. We show that uncertain size priors of familiar objects can jointly constrain a reconstruction's shared scale. Building on this insight, we present UniMetric, a universal and training-free metric scale recovery framework for geometry foundation models, without additional sensors or task-specific metric supervision. Specifically, Metric Prior Acquisition elicits object height intervals from a vision-language model. Semantic-Geometric Alignment measures reconstructed object heights along the estimated support-surface normal in each frame and converts the priors into scale intervals. Global Scale Recovery reconciles these intervals through a convex objective, yielding a jointly feasible scale when they overlap and a unique compromise otherwise. The estimated sequence-level scale is applied uniformly to reconstructed points and camera translations. Controlled experiments with real VLM priors show that combining observations improves scale accuracy with exact relative object heights. To evaluate metric accuracy on GFM reconstructions without ground-truth scale alignment, we introduce MetricBench, covering twelve embodied, driving, and roadside subsets with sensor-derived ground truth. Across nine geometry foundation models, UniMetric reduces mean depth Abs Rel, reconstruction Chamfer distance, and trajectory error by 54.2%, 83.8%, and 65.6%, respectively, improving every model on all three tasks at the suite level. We release the UniMetric code and MetricBench data.

papers.title_en: ASM-6D: Fast Certified Pose-Shape Inference with Complete Correspondence Flow Maps
papers.authors: Ho Jin Choi, Minku Kim, Nadia Figueroa
papers.evidence: 从RGB-D观测联合估计物体三维形状与六自由度位姿
papers.tldr: 类别级六维姿态与形状估计需从局部观测恢复未知实例的位姿和完整几何，遮挡使对应关系与姿态求解尤为困难。ASM-6D以生成式完整几何预测构造多个共享类别主动形状模型点身份的三维对应假设，并直接联合拟合旋转、平移、尺度和实例形状。方法解析消去平移与形状系数，将优化降至九变量缩放旋转问题，实现多假设批量实时评估。在ROPE和HouseCat6D上取得先进表现，并支持形状补全、跟踪与机器人抓取，展示统一表示的实用价值。
papers.abstract_en: Category-level 6D pose and shape estimation requires recovering an object's pose and geometry from partial observations without an exact instance model. We present ASM-6D, which couples generative complete-geometry prediction with explicit category-level pose-shape inference through shared correspondences. Given an RGB-D image, ASM-6D generates alternative complete 3D correspondence hypotheses whose point identities are shared with a category-level Active Shape Model (ASM), including occluded points. Each hypothesis is fitted directly for rotation, translation, metric scale, and instance shape without a separate correspondence-assignment stage. We analytically eliminate translation and shape coefficients, reducing fitting to a nine-variable scaled-rotation optimization problem that enables efficient batched evaluation of multiple hypotheses in real time. ASM-6D achieves state-of-the-art performance on ROPE and HouseCat6D benchmarks. Ablations demonstrate the importance of generative correspondence prediction and active shape variation. The representation also supports shape completion, shape-dependent pose ambiguity, tracking, and robotic grasping at 6-38 Hz, depending on the inference budget.

papers.title_en: ViewStruct: View-Grounded Articulation and Connectivity Inference
papers.authors: Wenjing Bian, Ranran Huang, Andreas Geiger
papers.evidence: 结合部件分割和深度预测刚体分组、连接及关节参数，支持语义部件结构理解。
papers.tldr: 面对陌生物体，仅凭外观难以判断部件如何连接、哪些部件刚性联动以及关节如何运动，进而限制物体理解与机器人操作。ViewStruct根据对齐的部件分割和深度，联合预测刚体分组、连接关系及关节参数，并将结构锚定到图像可见区域和重力对齐的视角坐标。它无需观察实际关节运动或逐实例优化，可在数秒内推断结构。实验表明，尽管仅用合成数据进行任务训练，该方法仍优于所测基线，并迁移至未见类别、资产来源和真实人机交互视频；预测关节还可用于生成模拟机器人运动轨迹。
papers.abstract_en: Interacting with unfamiliar objects requires understanding how their parts connect and move. We introduce ViewStruct, a framework for jointly predicting connectivity and articulation in objects and scenes. Given an RGB image with aligned part segmentation and depth, optionally supplemented by images or video, ViewStruct predicts rigid-body groupings, attachments, and joint parameters. Its view-grounded representation links predictions to observed regions and expresses joint geometry in a gravity-aligned, view-relative frame, without requiring category-specific canonical orientations. A pretrained vision--language model is adapted to predict structure in seconds, without requiring observed articulation motion or per-instance optimisation. Experiments demonstrate improved structural prediction over evaluated baselines and transfer to unseen categories, asset sources, and real-world human-interaction videos, despite task-specific training exclusively on synthetic data. Simulated manipulation experiments further demonstrate the utility of predicted joints for generating robot motion trajectories.

papers.title_en: Proactive Physical AI through Continuous Observation and Timely Intervention
papers.authors: Zhenhua Yang, Jiafeng Liang, Xingyu Zhou, Yi Jiang, Xiayu Cao, Zui Chen, Luqi Wang, Haiyang Sun, Yufei Xiang, Chang Li, Rongchuan Mu, Bowen Chi, Zihe Tong, Mingyu Li, Huijie Ma, Yiqiao Yang, Baoqi Ren, Zhiming Ma, Zhihao Zhu, Jiahao Ji, Zhuoyao Wang, Qianyu Wang, Xiangyu Liu, Wang Zixiang, Shunliang Zhang, Ming Liu, Xiaocheng Feng, Duyu Tang, Bing Qin
papers.evidence: 物理人工智能持续感知环境并自主决定何时行动
papers.tldr: 传统物理智能多在接到明确目标后才感知与行动，但现实中的需求常随环境变化而先于人的指令出现。本文提出主动式物理智能，要求系统持续观察环境、判断是否需要介入并把握时机。ProAgent结合流式主动时机模型StreamingJev与响应模型，生成建议或调用设备执行动作，并以视频自动构建时机监督数据。实验显示其在明确目标和持续角色设置下较骨干基线判断更准、误触发更少，真实机器人测试也能识别新兴需求并执行恰当动作。
papers.abstract_en: Physical AI is commonly formulated around an explicitly specified task: given a goal or instruction, a system perceives, reasons, and acts. In many real-world settings, however, important tasks emerge from continuously changing world states before a person explicitly formulates them. We study this complementary problem as Proactive Physical AI, where an AI system continuously observes the physical world, identifies situations that warrant intervention, and initiates appropriate actions at the right time. We develop ProAgent, an end-to-end system built around two components: a Jev-style proactive timing model (dubbed StreamingJev) that determines whether and when intervention is needed, and a Response Model that generates responses for people or invokes available device capabilities for physical execution. To support learning at scale, we develop an automated data pipeline that converts videos into supervision for proactive timing. Experiments demonstrate strong proactive performance under both explicit objectives and standing roles, combining more accurate intervention timing with fewer false triggers than the source-backbone baseline. Real-robot evaluations further demonstrate ProAgent's ability to identify emerging needs and translate them into appropriate physical actions.

papers.title_en: SWORD: Scene-Grounded Wasserstein Object-Relation Distance for 3D Scene Graph Prediction
papers.authors: U-Chae Jun, Jaeeun Ko, Yoonhyuk Choi, Jiwoo Kang
papers.evidence: 直接优化三维场景图中的对象角色与关系语义距离
papers.tldr: 三维场景图预测通常以对象节点和关系边分类训练，但精确标签损失无法表达错误预测与真值在语义上的远近，通用图距离还需处理节点匹配。SWORD利用既有协议中的固定节点索引与监督边槽位，将比较转化为对齐图距离问题。它从训练标注构造对象和关系地面度量，并将其提升为对齐节点及含空边边际分布上的 Wasserstein 距离。理论上该距离是严格度量，真值是唯一零距离解，并可上界解码语义误差，为场景图预测提供超越精确分类的语义监督。
papers.abstract_en: 3D scene graph prediction is commonly optimized with object-node and relation-edge classification losses. These objectives encourage exact object and relation label recovery, but they do not directly optimize semantic proximity to the ground-truth scene graph: two wrong graphs can receive comparable penalties even when one is much closer in object roles and relation contexts. A direct graph-distance loss is difficult in general, since graph matching and graph edit distance require correspondence search and edit-cost design. Our key observation is that prior supervised 3D scene graph prediction protocols are conducted on fixed object-node indices and supervised edge slots. This can turn a scene graph comparison into a well-defined aligned graph-distance problem. To this end, we propose SWORD, a Scene-Grounded Wasserstein Object-Relation Distance that builds block-normalized object and relation ground distance metrics from training scene graph annotations through a deterministic base-to-context order, without external semantic priors. SWORD lifts these metrics to Wasserstein distances over aligned node and null-augmented edge marginals, providing semantic graph-distance supervision beyond exact-label penalties while preserving the ground-truth graph as the unique zero-distance solution in aligned marginal probability space. We prove that SWORD is a strict metric on aligned marginal probabilistic scene graphs, preserves scene-graph-grounded substitution ordering, controls additive graph-grounded semantic observables, and yields a surrogate upper-bounding decoded semantic error.

papers.title_en: LVS: Local View Synthesis from Relative Camera Pose by Reusing Previous Views
papers.authors: Qizhou Huo, Xuan Sun, Yongfei Guo, Zhipeng Wang, Yuanhao Gong
papers.evidence: 以深度和相机相对位姿进行几何扭曲和新视角图像复用
papers.tldr: 交互式场景探索需要频繁更新视角，但相邻相机位姿下画面内容大多重叠，传统3D高斯泼溅仍需逐次重新渲染，造成计算浪费。LVS针对单个场景复用已渲染的RGB-D视图，依据相对位姿进行几何变形，并用轻量多尺度网络预测颜色残差、修正伪影和推断新显露区域，同时缓存源特征以减少重复计算。在GS-render上，残差细化较纯几何变形提升0.72 dB PSNR，实拍与合成场景评测也显示查询延迟较低。该方法分离场景渲染与邻近视角更新，为更灵敏的场景浏览及增强现实、虚拟现实应用提供支持。
papers.abstract_en: Interactive scene exploration requires frequent view updates, although small camera motions preserve much of the visible content. Conventional 3D Gaussian Splatting nevertheless renders each target view, leaving this image overlap unexploited. Reusing rendered images offers an alternative. Geometric warping alone cannot recover newly exposed content and remains sensitive to depth errors. We propose a per-scene framework that replaces repeated scene rendering for nearby views with relative-pose-guided RGB-D image reuse. Geometric warping uses depth and relative pose to transport source content, while a lightweight multiscale network predicts RGB residuals to correct artifacts and infer missing appearance. Cached source features further reduce repeated computation. On GS-render, residual refinement improves PSNR by 0.72~dB over pure warping; evaluations on captured and rendered scenes demonstrate low query latency. This separation of scene rendering from local view updates supports responsive scene exploration, with potential applications in augmented and virtual reality.

papers.title_en: GeoFix: Geometry Fixing for 4D Consistent Generation
papers.authors: Yeobin Hong, Hyojun Go, Dohun Lee, Jeongjae Lee, Sunghwan Hong, Federico Tombari, Zhaochong An, Jong Chul Ye, Konrad Schindler, Dominik Narnhofer
papers.evidence: 以跨视角深度一致性奖励改善生成场景的几何结构
papers.tldr: 视频扩散模型日益用于四维生成，但生成视频常出现几何不一致；现有几何奖励可能损害纹理和细节，还需额外外观奖励并仔细平衡。GeoFix提出统一框架，以静态场景区域的跨视角深度一致性作为单一几何奖励，并校准视场重叠对深度一致性的影响，可用于训练和推理阶段。该方法使WorldScore三维一致性提升39%，VBench质量分提高4%。其贡献在于不直接约束外观或惩罚有效运动，同时改善几何结构与视觉质量。
papers.abstract_en: Video diffusion models increasingly serve as priors for 4D generation, but the generated videos often lack geometric consistency. Recent approaches address this through post-training by designing geometric rewards, yet this can degrade texture and fine detail, requiring auxiliary appearance rewards and careful reward balancing. To address this challenge, we propose GeoFix, a unified framework that improves geometric consistency and visual quality with a single geometric reward, applicable to both training and inference-time reward alignment. Our reward measures cross-view depth consistency in static scene regions, targeting structural inconsistencies without directly constraining appearance or penalizing valid object motion. Crucially, depth agreement increases with camera field-of-view overlap even in real videos and 4D datasets, allowing a smaller camera movement to be mistaken for better geometry. We account for this effect by calibrating the reward against the overlap-dependent trend. GeoFix achieves a 39% improvement in WorldScore 3D consistency and a 4% increase in VBench Quality Score.

papers.title_en: DSR-Net: Learning Dynamic Skeletal Relations for 3D Human Pose Estimation
papers.authors: Fan Li, Jian Xiang, LinLin Xue, Yuwei Gao
papers.evidence: 针对三维人体姿态估计的动态骨架关系建模，与具身智能中的身体运动理解相关。
papers.tldr: 三维人体姿态估计需要刻画随动作变化的骨骼结构及关节依赖，但固定图拓扑与隐式注意力难以适应多样运动模式。DSR-Net通过动态骨骼关系模块学习预定义连接之外的关节依赖，并以层级关系感知融合交互结构与时序表示，结合轻量残差骨骼重校准提升特征稳定性。在Human3.6M和MPI-INF-3DHP上分别取得37.9毫米与14.9毫米的平均关节位置误差，优于强基线。结果表明，动态结构关系建模能有效提升三维姿态估计的鲁棒性。
papers.abstract_en: 3D human pose estimation requires accurate modeling of motion-dependent skeletal structures and inter-joint dependencies. Existing methods typically rely on fixed skeletal topologies in Graph Convolutional Networks (GCNs) or implicitly capture joint relations through attention mechanisms, limiting their adaptability to diverse motion patterns. To address this issue,we proposeDSR-Net, a dynamic structural representation learning framework for 3D human pose estimation. Specifically, a Dynamic Skeletal Relation (DSR) module is introduced to learn adaptive inter-joint dependencies beyond predefined skeletal connections. Based on the learned relations, a hierarchical relation-aware fusion strategy is developed to facilitate effective interaction between structural and temporal representations. In addition, a lightweight Residual Skeletal Recalibration Module (RSRM) is designed to enhance the stability of structure-aware features with minimal computational overhead. Extensive experiments on Human3.6M and MPI-INF-3DHP demonstrate that DSR-Net achieves MPJPEs of 37.9 mm and 14.9 mm, respectively, consistently improving over strong baselines. The results validate the effectiveness of dynamic skeletal relation modeling for robust 3D human pose estimation.

papers.title_en: ScenePlacer: Reformulating Scene-Level Object Pose Estimation as Visibility Field Learning
papers.authors: Ken Deng, Jiarui Liu, Guibiao Liao, Kunming Luo, Mochu Xiang, Hongyu Yan, Yebin Liu, Shenghua Gao, Yizhou Yu, Ping Tan
papers.evidence: 利用部分几何观测估计场景级物体位姿
papers.tldr: 场景级物体位姿估计需将生成的三维物体与重建所得局部点云对齐，但直接在生成过程中回归位姿易受尺度歧义和缺失观测影响。ScenePlacer将生成与定位解耦，预测物体坐标系中的可见性场，并据此匹配观测和网格可见部分。它以物体网格和渲染视图合成训练数据，结合可见性感知监督，无需场景级位姿标注。在三维未来数据集上，该方法优于现有基线，估计深度下F分数达92.40，真值几何下达98.27。该框架保留生成模型的形状先验，并提升场景放置精度。
papers.abstract_en: We present ScenePlacer, a framework for scene-level pose estimation of objects generated by state-of-the-art native shape generation models, placing generated 3D objects into scenes given a partial geometric observation without modifying the underlying generative pipeline. Existing scene generation approaches either generate objects directly in scene coordinates, compromising their canonical-space priors, or regress poses from complete generated shapes in the shape generation process - the latter being a poorly conditioned problem that is sensitive to scale ambiguity and partial observations. ScenePlacer decouples object generation from pose estimation by reformulating alignment as conditional visibility-field learning. Given an observed partial point cloud from reconstruction and a generated mesh, it predicts a visibility field defined in object space, then estimates the rigid transformation by aligning the partial observation to visible parts on the mesh. We propose a pretrained 3D shape VAE as our backbone, preserving its mesh prior while conditioning it on a separately encoded observation. We further introduce visibility-aware, radius-constrained supervision and synthesize training pairs using only object-level meshes and rendered views, eliminating the need for scene-level pose annotations. On 3D-FUTURE, ScenePlacer consistently outperforms existing placement and pose-refinement baselines under both ground-truth and monocular depth estimation. With generated objects, it achieves a Chamfer distance of 0.0077 and an F-score of 92.40 under estimated depth and improves to 0.0023 and 98.27, respectively, under ground-truth geometry.

papers.title_en: GHOST: Geometry-Constrained Hybrid Diffusion for Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Graph Generation
papers.authors: Changqun Feng, Wangxiandi Yin, Xin Hu, Ruiting Dai, Feiyang Yang, Jielei Wang, Tao He
papers.evidence: 联合建模场景图节点几何与语义关系，支持三维场景空间结构理解。
papers.tldr: 3D场景图生成既要识别物体语义，也要准确刻画度量空间关系，但开放词汇方法容易把语言共现误当成几何依据，造成空间谓词预测偏差。GHOST采用几何约束混合扩散，联合建模连续节点几何与离散边谓词，依照“几何—约束—谓词”逐步去噪。模型从谓词语言嵌入中诱导可微几何约束，并通过几何—拓扑协同去噪器共同优化布局和关系预测。在3DSSG上，GHOST在闭集与开放词汇设置均达到最先进表现，空间谓词较RelationField提升超过17个百分点，说明显式几何约束有助于可靠生成开放词汇3D场景图。
papers.abstract_en: 3D scene graph generation requires understanding both object semantics and metric spatial relations. However, existing open-vocabulary methods often struggle with spatial predicates because language similarity reflects semantic co-occurrence rather than explicit geometry. We propose GHOST, a Geometry-constrained Hybrid diffusion framework for Open-vocabulary 3D Scene graph generaTion. GHOST jointly models continuous node geometry and discrete edge predicates, following a geometry-to-constraint-to-predicate denoising process to ensure geometrically consistent relation prediction. It introduces language-grounded constraint induction, which maps predicate embeddings to differentiable geometric constraints that guide both layout refinement and predicate reweighting. A Geometry-Topology Collaborative Denoiser further couples node and edge reasoning through noise-adaptive interaction and orientation-aware modeling. Experiments on 3DSSG demonstrate state-of-the-art performance in both closed-set and open-vocabulary settings, including over 17-point gains over RelationField on spatial predicates.
